minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  April 04, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900 -6833,
meeting ID: 850 2420 9204 and Password 505073 on April 04, 2024, at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Cpt. Reginald Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Kenrick Sanderlin, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

New Business License Request (s):

Item #1:  Jaben Inc. DBA HPC to operate as Guard Service at 3883 W. Century Blvd
  APPROVED  CONDITIONALLY  SUBJECT  TO  THE  FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees;
  Maintain valid and current Private Patrol Operator License from the Department of
  Consumer Affairs, Bureau of Security and Investigative Services; Security Guards must
  be licensed with the Department of Consumer Affairs, Bureau of Security and
  Investigative Services; Business owner/facility is strictly prohibited from hiring or
  employing any person registered under California Penal Code Section 290 PC or
  any person that may pose a public safety risk/threat to patients or other employees
  at the location; and Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any
  future business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00384224)
 Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
